parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English

parameters.name: AddressLbStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy for the addresses in the address pool.

- round\_robin: Round robin. For each DNS query, all addresses are returned in a rotating order.

- sequence: Sequence. The address with the highest priority is returned. Priority is determined by the ordinal number of an address. A smaller ordinal number indicates a higher priority. If an address is unavailable, the address with the next highest priority is returned.

- weight: Weight. DNS queries are resolved based on the weight that you set for each address.

- source\_nearest: Source nearest. This is an intelligent DNS resolution feature. GTM returns an address based on the source of the DNS query. This directs users to the nearest resource.

parameters.name: AddressPoolId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: SequenceLbStrategyMode
parameters.description:
The recovery mode when the load balancing policy is \`sequence\`.

- preemptive: Preemptive mode. If a higher-priority address recovers, it is used preferentially.

- non\_preemptive: Non-preemptive mode. If a higher-priority address recovers, the current address continues to be used.
